service: Anti-Rabies Vaccination for Walk-In Dog/Cat Owners
description: Registers and vaccinates eligible dogs and cats against rabies in support of Republic Act No. 9482 and a rabies-free Meycauayan City.
steps: Create or present the required online registration account and bring the dog or cat, a valid ID, and an active smartphone/SIM.
Assist in safely restraining the pet during assessment and vaccination.
Receive the vaccination record and post-vaccination instructions.
requirements: Smartphone with an active SIM for online registration
Dog or cat to be vaccinated
Valid government-issued ID of the client

detailedRequirements.requirement: Smartphone with an active SIM for online registration
Dog or cat to be vaccinated
Valid government-issued ID of the client

clientSteps.action: Bring the pet and valid ID, then present or create the required online registration account.
Assist in restraining the pet while veterinary personnel assess it for vaccination.
The vaccine is administered and the vaccination record is completed.
Receive the vaccination record and post-vaccination instructions.

processingTime: Approximately 50 minutes, excluding queueing and clinical assessment

description: Provides accessible medical consultations, dental consultations, oral prophylaxis, tooth extraction, patient assessment, and related primary health services through Meycauayan's City Health Units.
officeDivision: Office of the City Health Officer
steps: Visit the City Health Unit serving your barangay and proceed to the Health Information Desk.
Provide your personal information, chief complaint, and vital signs for recording.
Secure a queue number and wait to be called.
Undergo the appropriate medical or dental consultation and treatment.
Follow the health professional's instructions and prescribed treatment.

clientSteps.step: Proceed to the Health Information Desk for record verification.
clientSteps.action: Retrieve the existing Individual Treatment Record or create a new patient record.

clientSteps.step: Provide your personal information at the designated Health Information Desk.
clientSteps.action: Record the patient's profile, chief complaint, and vital signs.

clientSteps.step: Secure a queue number and wait to be called.
clientSteps.action: Provide a number on a first-come, first-served basis and in accordance with accessibility laws.
Assess and examine the patient using the Individual Treatment Record and the patient's presenting signs and symptoms.

clientSteps.step: Wait for the result of the medical examination.
clientSteps.action: Interpret and explain laboratory results, issue a medical certificate, or request laboratory examinations when necessary.
Advise the patient and prescribe medication when appropriate.
